verdict: Clean, fully real implementation. Uses only genuine Baklava API verified in the CEM: bl-switch with checked, bl-select with name/label/help-text, and bl-select-option with value (correct camelCase tag, no hallucinated bl-option). Default slots and hint text via span in the switch label and help-text on the select are all real. No wrapper divs, inline styles, or hand-rolled native controls; each toggle and the dropdown are real components carrying proper labels.
